people.descriptor: Consort of King Huai of Chu
Prince and Prime Minister of Chu

units.zh: 屈原者，名平，楚之同姓也。
units.en: Qu Yuan, whose given name was Ping, shared the royal surname of the state of Chu.
units.literal: Qu Yuan, named Ping, Chu same clan.

units.zh: 為楚懷王左徒。
units.en: He served as Left Minister to King Huai of Chu.
units.literal: Served Chu Huai Wang Left Tutor.

units.zh: 博聞彊志，明於治亂，嫻于辭令。
units.en: He was widely learned with a powerful memory, well versed in the principles of governance and disorder, and eloquent in speech and composition.
units.literal: Broad learning strong will, clear on order chaos, skilled in rhetoric.

units.zh: 入則與王圖議國事，以出號令；
units.en: At court, he deliberated affairs of state with the king and drafted royal edicts;
units.literal: Enter then with king plan discuss state affairs, to issue commands;

units.zh: 出則接遇賓客，應對諸侯。
units.en: Abroad, he received envoys and conducted diplomacy with the feudal lords.
units.literal: Exit then receive guests, respond to feudal lords.

units.zh: 王甚任之。
units.en: The king placed great trust in him.
units.literal: King greatly relied on him.

units.zh: 上官大夫與之同列，爭寵而心害其能。
units.en: Grand Master Shangguan, who held the same rank, vied with him for the king's favor and secretly resented his abilities.
units.literal: Shangguan Chamberlain with him same rank, competed favor yet heart resented his ability.

units.zh: 懷王使屈原造為憲令，屈平屬草槁未定。
units.en: King Huai charged Qu Yuan with drafting a new code of laws. Qu Ping had composed a rough draft but had not yet finalized it.
units.literal: Huai Wang made Qu Yuan draft constitutional laws, Qu Ping had just finished draft not yet decided.

units.zh: 上官大夫見而欲奪之，屈平不與，因讒之曰：「王使屈平為令，眾莫不知，每一令出，平伐其功，（曰）以為『非我莫能為』也。」
units.en: Grand Master Shangguan saw the draft and wished to claim it for himself. When Qu Ping refused to hand it over, Shangguan slandered him before the king, saying: 'Your Majesty commissioned Qu Ping to draft these laws, and everyone knows it. Yet each time a new decree is issued, Ping boasts of the achievement, claiming that no one else could have done it.'
units.literal: Shangguan Chamberlain saw and wished seize it, Qu Ping not give, therefore slandered said: 'King made Qu Ping for laws, crowd none not know, every time law out, Ping boasted merit, said 'only I can do'.'

units.zh: 王怒而疏屈平。
units.en: The king grew angry and distanced himself from Qu Ping.
units.literal: King angered distanced Qu Ping.

units.zh: 屈平疾王聽之不聰也，讒諂之蔽明也，邪曲之害公也，方正之不容也，故憂愁幽思而作離騷。
units.en: Qu Ping was pained that the king's judgment was so easily clouded, that slander and flattery obscured his wisdom, that the crooked and corrupt harmed the public good, and that the upright found no place at court. And so, in deep sorrow and brooding anguish, he composed the 'Encountering Sorrow.'
units.literal: Qu Ping grieved king listening not wise, slander flattery blocked clarity, crooked harmed justice, upright not tolerated, therefore worried sorrowful deep thought composed Li Sao.

units.zh: 離騷者，猶離憂也。
units.en: The title 'Encountering Sorrow' means, in essence, parting from sorrow.
units.literal: 'Li Sao' is like 'li you' (parting from sorrow).

units.zh: 夫天者，人之始也；
units.en: Heaven is the origin of all people;
units.literal: That heaven, people beginning;

units.zh: 父母者，人之本也。
units.en: Parents are the root of every person.
units.literal: Parents, people root.

units.zh: 人窮則反本，故勞苦倦極，未嘗不呼天也；
units.en: When people are driven to extremity, they return to their roots. Thus, in the depths of toil and exhaustion, they never fail to cry out to Heaven;
units.literal: People poor then return to roots, therefore labor toil exhausted extreme, never not call heaven;

units.zh: 疾痛慘怛，未嘗不呼父母也。
units.en: In the anguish of sickness and suffering, they never fail to call out to their parents.
units.literal: Illness pain bitter sorrow, never not call parents.

units.zh: 屈平正道直行，竭忠盡智以事其君，讒人閒之，可謂窮矣。
units.en: Qu Ping walked the straight path and acted with integrity, exhausting his loyalty and wisdom in service to his lord, yet slanderers drove a wedge between them. One may truly say he was driven to the uttermost extremity.
units.literal: Qu Ping correct path straight conduct, exhausted loyalty wisdom to serve his lord, slanderers separated them, can be called poor indeed.

units.zh: 信而見疑，忠而被謗，能無怨乎？
units.en: To be trusted yet met with suspicion, to be loyal yet slandered — how could he not feel resentment?
units.literal: Faithful yet seen suspicious, loyal yet slandered, can have no resentment?

units.zh: 屈平之作離騷，蓋自怨生也。
units.en: Qu Ping's composition of the 'Encountering Sorrow' was born from just such resentment.
units.literal: Qu Ping's composing Li Sao was probably born from resentment.

units.zh: 國風好色而不淫，小雅怨誹而不亂。
units.en: The 'Airs of the States' delights in beauty without becoming licentious; the 'Lesser Odes' expresses resentment without descending into disorder.
units.literal: Guo Feng loves beauty not licentious, Xiao Ya resents criticizes not chaotic.

units.zh: 若離騷者，可謂兼之矣。
units.en: The 'Encountering Sorrow' may be said to unite both these virtues.
units.literal: As for Li Sao, can be said combines them.

units.zh: 上稱帝嚳，下道齊桓，中述湯武，以刺世事。
units.en: It invokes Emperor Ku in the remote past, speaks of Duke Huan of Qi in recent times, and recounts the deeds of Tang and Wu in between — all to cast light on the affairs of the present age.
units.literal: Above mentions Emperor Ku, below speaks Duke Huan, middle describes Tang Wu, to criticize current affairs.

units.zh: 明道德之廣崇，治亂之條貫，靡不畢見。
units.en: It illuminates the breadth and grandeur of moral virtue and the patterns underlying order and chaos, leaving nothing unexamined.
units.literal: Clarifies morality broad elevation, governance chaos systematic order, nothing not completely seen.

units.zh: 其文約，其辭微，其志絜，其行廉，其稱文小而其指極大，舉類邇而見義遠。
units.en: Its language is concise, its diction subtle, its aspirations pure, its conduct unblemished. Its allusions may seem trifling, but their significance is vast; the examples it draws upon are near at hand, yet the principles they illuminate reach far.
units.literal: Its text concise, its words subtle, its will pure, its conduct clean, its references small yet its meaning extremely great, cites nearby examples yet sees far justice.

units.zh: 其志絜，故其稱物芳。
units.en: Because its aspirations are pure, it speaks of fragrant things.
units.literal: Its will pure, therefore its named things fragrant.

units.zh: 其行廉，故死而不容自疏。
units.en: Because its conduct is unblemished, he would sooner die than allow himself to be estranged from virtue.
units.literal: Its conduct clean, therefore died not allowing self distant.

units.zh: 濯淖汙泥之中，蟬蛻於濁穢，以浮游塵埃之外，不獲世之滋垢，皭然泥而不滓者也。
units.en: He cleansed himself amid the mire and filth, shed his skin like a cicada leaving behind corruption, and floated free beyond the dust of the world. He refused to let the grime of his age stain him — a man who passed through the mud yet emerged without a blemish.
units.literal: Washed mud filth midst, cicada molted foulness, to float roam dust outside, not obtaining world accumulated filth, pure unstained mud not dregs.

units.zh: 推此志也，雖與日月爭光可也。
units.en: Judging by such resolve, one may say that his brilliance could rival even the sun and moon.
units.literal: Pushing this ambition, even with sun moon contend light possible.

units.zh: 屈平既絀，其後秦欲伐齊，齊與楚從親，惠王患之，乃令張儀詳去秦，厚幣委質事楚，曰：「秦甚憎齊，齊與楚從親，楚誠能絕齊，秦願獻商、於之地六百里。」
units.en: After Qu Ping had been dismissed, Qin wished to attack Qi. Since Qi and Chu had formed a close alliance, King Hui of Qin grew alarmed. He dispatched Zhang Yi, who feigned departure from Qin's service and arrived in Chu bearing lavish gifts, pledging himself as a vassal. Zhang Yi told the king of Chu: 'Qin despises Qi, and Qi has allied itself closely with Chu. If Chu would truly sever its ties with Qi, Qin is willing to cede six hundred li of the Shang and Yu territories.'
units.literal: Qu Ping already dismissed, after this Qin wished attack Qi, Qi with Chu allied closely, Hui Wang worried it, then had Zhang Yi pretend leave Qin, thick gifts humble serve Chu, said: 'Qin greatly hates Qi, Qi with Chu allied closely. Chu truly can break Qi, Qin wishes offer Shang Yu lands 600 li.'

units.zh: 楚懷王貪而信張儀，遂絕齊，使使如秦受地。
units.en: King Huai of Chu, blinded by greed, believed Zhang Yi. He severed relations with Qi and sent an envoy to Qin to claim the promised territory.
units.literal: Chu Huai Wang greedy believed Zhang Yi, thus broke Qi, sent envoy to Qin receive land.

units.zh: 張儀詐之曰：「儀與王約六里，不聞六百里。」
units.en: Zhang Yi deceived them, saying: 'I agreed with the king on six li. I never heard anything about six hundred.'
units.literal: Zhang Yi deceived them said: 'Yi with king agreed six li, not heard six hundred li.'

units.zh: 楚使怒去，歸告懷王。
units.en: The Chu envoy departed in fury and returned to report to King Huai.
units.literal: Chu envoy angered left, returned told Huai Wang.

units.zh: 懷王怒，大興師伐秦。
units.en: King Huai was enraged and raised a great army to attack Qin.
units.literal: Huai Wang angered, greatly raised troops attacked Qin.

units.zh: 秦發兵擊之，大破楚師於丹、淅，斬首八萬，虜楚將屈丐，遂取楚之漢中地。
units.en: Qin sent its forces to meet them and dealt a crushing defeat to the Chu army at Dan and Xi, beheading eighty thousand soldiers and capturing the Chu general Qu Gai. Qin then seized the Hanzhong territories of Chu.
units.literal: Qin sent troops struck them, greatly defeated Chu army at Dan Xi, beheaded eighty thousand, captured Chu general Qu Gai, thus took Chu Hanzhong land.

units.zh: 懷王乃悉發國中兵以深入擊秦，戰於藍田。
units.en: King Huai then mobilized every soldier in the realm for a deep thrust into Qin, and the two sides clashed at Lantian.
units.literal: Huai Wang then sent all state troops to deeply attack Qin, battled at Lantian.

units.zh: 魏聞之，襲楚至鄧。
units.en: Wei, learning of this, launched a surprise attack on Chu and advanced as far as Deng.
units.literal: Wei heard it, attacked Chu to Deng.

units.zh: 楚兵懼，自秦歸。
units.en: The Chu forces grew fearful and withdrew from Qin.
units.literal: Chu troops feared, from Qin returned.

units.zh: 而齊竟怒不救楚，楚大困。
units.en: Qi, still furious at Chu's betrayal, refused to come to its aid, and Chu was left in dire straits.
units.literal: And Qi finally angered not rescued Chu, Chu greatly distressed.

units.zh: 明年，秦割漢中地與楚以和。
units.en: The following year, Qin offered to cede the Hanzhong territory to Chu in exchange for peace.
units.literal: Next year, Qin ceded Hanzhong land to Chu for peace.

units.zh: 楚王曰：「不願得地，願得張儀而甘心焉。」
units.en: The king of Chu declared: 'I do not want the land. I want Zhang Yi — only then will my heart be satisfied.'
units.literal: Chu Wang said: 'Not wish get land, wish get Zhang Yi satisfy hatred.'

units.zh: 張儀聞，乃曰：「以一儀而當漢中地，臣請往如楚。」
units.en: When Zhang Yi heard this, he said: 'If one Zhang Yi is worth the Hanzhong territory, then let me go to Chu.'
units.literal: Zhang Yi heard, then said: 'With one Zhang Yi match Hanzhong land, minister requests go to Chu.'

units.zh: 如楚，又因厚幣用事者臣靳尚，而設詭辯於懷王之寵姬鄭袖。
units.en: He went to Chu and bribed the powerful minister Jin Shang with lavish gifts, then contrived through cunning arguments to win over King Huai's favored consort, Zheng Xiu.
units.literal: Went to Chu, moreover used thick gifts influential minister Jin Shang, set up deceptive arguments with Huai Wang favored concubine Zheng Xiu.

units.zh: 懷王竟聽鄭袖，復釋去張儀。
units.en: In the end, King Huai heeded Zheng Xiu and released Zhang Yi once again.
units.literal: Huai Wang finally listened Zheng Xiu, again released Zhang Yi.

units.zh: 是時屈平既疏，不復在位，使於齊，顧反，諫懷王曰：「何不殺張儀？」
units.en: At that time, Qu Ping had already been estranged and was no longer in office. He had been sent on a mission to Qi, and upon his return, he remonstrated with King Huai: 'Why not execute Zhang Yi?'
units.literal: This time Qu Ping already alienated, no longer in position, sent to Qi; upon returning, advised Huai Wang said: 'Why not kill Zhang Yi?'

units.zh: 懷王悔，追張儀不及。
units.en: King Huai was filled with regret and sent men to pursue Zhang Yi, but they could not catch him.
units.literal: Huai Wang regretted, pursued Zhang Yi could not catch.

units.zh: 其後諸侯共擊楚，大破之，殺其將唐眛。
units.en: Afterward, the feudal lords joined forces against Chu, dealt it a crushing defeat, and slew its general Tang Mei.
units.literal: After this feudal lords together attacked Chu, greatly defeated them, killed their general Tang Mei.

units.zh: 時秦昭王與楚婚，欲與懷王會。
units.en: At that time, King Zhao of Qin had formed a marriage alliance with Chu and wished to meet with King Huai.
units.literal: At this time Qin Zhao Wang married with Chu, wished to meet with Huai Wang.

units.zh: 懷王欲行，屈平曰：「秦虎狼之國，不可信，不如毋行。」
units.en: King Huai intended to go, but Qu Ping warned him: 'Qin is a land of tigers and wolves. It cannot be trusted. Better not to go.'
units.literal: Huai Wang wished go, Qu Ping said: 'Qin tiger wolf country, cannot trust, better not go.'

units.zh: 懷王稚子子蘭勸王行：「柰何絕秦歡！」
units.en: But King Huai's youngest son, Zi Lan, urged the king to go: 'How can we sever our friendship with Qin!'
units.literal: Huai Wang young son Zi Lan advised king go: 'How break Qin friendship!'

units.zh: 懷王卒行。
units.en: In the end, King Huai went.
units.literal: Huai Wang finally went.

units.zh: 入武關，秦伏兵絕其後，因留懷王，以求割地。
units.en: When he entered the Wu Pass, Qin troops sprang from ambush and cut off his retreat. They detained King Huai and demanded that he cede territory.
units.literal: Entered Wuguan, Qin ambush troops cut off their rear, thus detained Huai Wang to demand ceding land.

units.zh: 懷王怒，不聽。
units.en: King Huai was furious and refused.
units.literal: Huai Wang angered, did not listen.

units.zh: 亡走趙，趙不內。
units.en: He escaped and fled to Zhao, but Zhao refused him entry.
units.literal: Fled to Zhao, Zhao not admit.

units.zh: 復之秦，竟死於秦而歸葬。
units.en: He was returned to Qin, where he eventually died. His body was sent home for burial.
units.literal: Returned to Qin, finally died in Qin returned for burial.

units.zh: 長子頃襄王立，以其弟子蘭為令尹。
units.en: The eldest son ascended the throne as King Qingxiang and appointed his younger brother Zi Lan as Prime Minister.
units.literal: Eldest son King Qingxiang established, made his younger brother Zi Lan prime minister.

units.zh: 楚人既咎子蘭以勸懷王入秦而不反也。
units.en: The people of Chu already blamed Zi Lan for having urged King Huai to enter Qin, whence he never returned.
units.literal: Chu people already blamed Zi Lan for advising Huai Wang enter Qin not return.

units.zh: 屈平既嫉之，雖放流，睠顧楚國，系心懷王，不忘欲反，冀幸君之一悟，俗之一改也。
units.en: Qu Ping loathed Zi Lan. Though banished, he remained devoted to the state of Chu. His heart was bound to King Huai, and he never ceased longing for his return to court, hoping that the king might one day awaken to the truth and that the corruption of the age might be reformed.
units.literal: Qu Ping already hated him, though banished, fondly regarded Chu state, tied heart Huai Wang, not forget wished return, hoped king one awakening, customs one change.

units.zh: 其存君興國而欲反覆之，一篇之中三致志焉。
units.en: His desire to preserve his lord and restore the state, to reverse its decline — this resolve is expressed three times within a single poem.
units.literal: His preserve lord revive country wish reverse it, one chapter three times expressed will.

units.zh: 然終無可柰何，故不可以反，卒以此見懷王之終不悟也。
units.en: Yet in the end, nothing could be done. He could not return to court, and so he came to see at last that King Huai would never awaken.
units.literal: Yet finally nothing could be done, therefore could not return, finally thus saw Huai Wang final lack of awakening.

units.zh: 人君無愚智賢不肖，莫不欲求忠以自為，舉賢以自佐，然亡國破家相隨屬，而聖君治國累世而不見者，其所謂忠者不忠，而所謂賢者不賢也。
units.en: Every ruler, whether foolish or wise, worthy or unworthy, wishes to find loyal ministers to serve him and to elevate the worthy to assist him. Yet states collapse and families are ruined in unbroken succession, while sage rulers who bring lasting order are not seen for generations on end. This is because those they called loyal were not truly loyal, and those they called worthy were not truly worthy.
units.literal: Rulers regardless foolish wise worthy unworthy, none not wish seek loyal for themselves, raise worthy assist themselves, yet ruined states broken families follow succession, yet sage kings govern states generations not appear - what they called loyal not loyal, what they called worthy not worthy.

units.zh: 懷王以不知忠臣之分，故內惑於鄭袖，外欺於張儀，疏屈平而信上官大夫、令尹子蘭。
units.en: Because King Huai could not distinguish a loyal minister from a false one, he was beguiled within by Zheng Xiu and deceived without by Zhang Yi. He cast aside Qu Ping and placed his trust in Grand Master Shangguan and the Prime Minister Zi Lan.
units.literal: Huai Wang because not know loyal ministers distinction, therefore internally confused by Zheng Xiu, externally deceived by Zhang Yi, alienated Qu Ping trusted Chamberlain Shangguan, Prime Minister Zi Lan.

units.zh: 兵挫地削，亡其六郡，身客死於秦，為天下笑。
units.en: His armies were routed, his territory stripped away, and six commanderies were lost. He himself died a captive in Qin, and became a laughingstock to all under Heaven.
units.literal: Army defeated land reduced, lost six commanderies, body died as guest in Qin, became world laughingstock.

units.zh: 此不知人之禍也。
units.en: Such is the calamity of failing to know men.
units.literal: This not know people calamity.

units.zh: 《易》曰：「井泄不食，為我心惻，可以汲。
units.en: The Book of Changes says: 'The well seeps but none drink from it — this grieves my heart. Yet water may still be drawn.
units.literal: The 'Yi' says: 'The well is cleared yet none drink from it — this grieves my heart; water may still be drawn.

units.zh: 王明，并受其福。」
units.en: When the king is wise, all share in his blessings.'
units.literal: King enlightened, all receive its blessing.'

units.zh: 王之不明，豈足福哉！
units.en: But when the king lacks wisdom, how can there be any blessing at all!
units.literal: King lack of enlightenment, how sufficient blessing!

units.zh: 令尹子蘭聞之大怒，卒使上官大夫短屈原於頃襄王，頃襄王怒而遷之。
units.en: When Prime Minister Zi Lan heard of this, he was enraged. He had Grand Master Shangguan speak against Qu Yuan before King Qingxiang. The king, in his anger, banished Qu Yuan.
units.literal: Prime Minister Zi Lan heard greatly angered, finally made Chamberlain Shangguan slander Qu Yuan to King Qingxiang, King Qingxiang angered banished him.

units.zh: 屈原至於江濱，被髪行吟澤畔。
units.en: Qu Yuan came to the banks of the river. With his hair unbound, he wandered along the marshy shore, chanting as he walked.
units.literal: Qu Yuan arrived at Jiang shore, disheveled hair walking reciting marsh side.

units.zh: 顏色憔悴，形容枯槁。
units.en: His face was haggard, his body gaunt and wasted.
units.literal: Color haggard, appearance withered.

units.zh: 漁父見而問之曰：「子非三閭大夫歟？
units.en: A fisherman saw him and asked: 'Are you not the Grand Master of the Three Wards?
units.literal: Fisherman saw asked him said: 'You not San Lu official?

units.zh: 何故而至此？」
units.en: What has brought you to this?'
units.literal: Why come to this?'

units.zh: 屈原曰：「舉世混濁而我獨清，眾人皆醉而我獨醒，是以見放。」
units.en: Qu Yuan replied: 'The whole world is muddied, yet I alone remain clear. All men are drunk, yet I alone am sober. That is why I have been cast out.'
units.literal: Qu Yuan said: 'Whole world turbid yet I alone clear, everyone drunk yet I alone sober, therefore banished.'

units.zh: 漁父曰：「夫聖人者，不凝滯於物而能與世推移。
units.en: The fisherman said: 'A sage does not cling rigidly to things, but moves with the current of the world.
units.literal: Fisherman said: 'Sage people not congealed stagnant in things can shift with world.

units.zh: 舉世混濁，何不隨其流而揚其波？
units.en: If all the world is muddied, why not go with its flow and ride its waves?
units.literal: Whole world turbid, why not follow its flow raise its waves?

units.zh: 眾人皆醉，何不餔其糟而啜其醨？
units.en: If all men are drunk, why not eat the dregs and sip the thin wine along with them?
units.literal: Everyone drunk, why not eat its dregs drink its thin wine?

units.zh: 何故懷瑾握瑜而自令見放為？」
units.en: Why cling so tightly to your jade and jewels that you bring banishment upon yourself?'
units.literal: Why hold jade and grasp gems, yet bring banishment upon yourself?'

units.zh: 屈原曰：「吾聞之，新沐者必彈冠，新浴者必振衣，人又誰能以身之察察，受物之汶汶者乎！
units.en: Qu Yuan replied: 'I have heard that one who has just washed his hair must dust off his cap, and one who has just bathed must shake out his robes. How can anyone, with a body so clean, allow himself to be sullied by the filth of the world!
units.literal: Qu Yuan said: 'I heard, newly bathed must flick cap, newly washed must shake clothes, who can with body clean, receive things dirty!

units.zh: 寧赴常流而葬乎江魚腹中耳，又安能以皓皓之白而蒙世俗之溫蠖乎！」
units.en: I would sooner cast myself into the river's ceaseless flow and be buried in the bellies of the fish, than let my radiant purity be smothered by the dust of this vulgar world!'
units.literal: Rather go constant flow bury Jiang fish belly, how can with bright white covered world dust!'

units.zh: 乃作懷沙之賦。
units.en: He then composed the rhapsody 'Embracing Sand.'
units.literal: Then composed Huai Sha assignment.

units.zh: 其辭曰：
units.en: Its words read:
units.literal: Its words said:

units.zh: 陶陶孟夏兮，草木莽莽。
units.en: In the warmth of early summer, the grasses and trees grow wild and lush.
units.literal: Bustling mid-summer, vegetation lush.

units.zh: 傷懷永哀兮，汩徂南土。
units.en: My wounded heart aches with endless sorrow, as I am swept away to the southern lands.
units.literal: Wounded heart eternal sorrow, rushing to southern land.

units.zh: 眴兮窈窈，孔靜幽墨。
units.en: All is dim and fathomless, a vast silence shrouded in darkness.
units.literal: Dazzling deep dark, greatly quiet mysterious dark.

units.zh: 冤結紆軫兮，離愍之長鞠；
units.en: My grievances coil and knot within me, and the anguish of my exile stretches on without end;
units.literal: Grievance knotted twisted pained, separated pity long drawn out;

units.zh: 撫情效志兮，俛詘以自抑。
units.en: I steady my feelings and hold fast to my purpose, bowing low to restrain myself.
units.literal: Caress feelings follow will, bow bend self restrain.

units.zh: 刓方以為圜兮，常度未替；
units.en: They would grind what is square to make it round, yet the eternal standard remains unchanged;
units.literal: Blunt square make round, constant measure not changed;

units.zh: 易初本由兮，君子所鄙。
units.en: to abandon one's original nature and principles is what the true gentleman despises.
units.literal: Change beginning follow by, gentleman despised.

units.zh: 章畫職墨兮，前度未改；
units.en: The compass lines are drawn, and the ink marks set; the old standards have not been altered;
units.literal: Clear markings duty ink, previous measure not changed;

units.zh: 內直質重兮，大人所盛。
units.en: inner rectitude and steadfast substance are what the great man esteems.
units.literal: Inner straight quality heavy, great man esteemed.

units.zh: 巧匠不斲兮，孰察其揆正？
units.en: If the skillful craftsman does not carve, who will discern that the timber is true?
units.literal: Skillful craftsman not chisel, who discerns its standard correctness?

units.zh: 玄文幽處兮，矇謂之不章；
units.en: Profound patterns lie hidden in the deep, and the blind call them obscure;
units.literal: Dark writings hidden place, blind call not clear;

units.zh: 離婁微睇兮，瞽以為無明。
units.en: Li Lou barely glances, and the sightless declare there is no light.
units.literal: Li Lou slight glance, blind consider no sight.

units.zh: 變白而為黑兮，倒上以為下。
units.en: They turn white to black and reverse what is above to make it below.
units.literal: Change white become black, invert upper become lower.

units.zh: 鳳皇在笯兮，雞雉翔舞。
units.en: The phoenix is caged, while the chickens and pheasants soar and dance.
units.literal: Phoenix in cage, chickens pheasants fly dance.

units.zh: 同糅玉石兮，一而相量。
units.en: Jade and common stone are jumbled together and weighed as one.
units.literal: Mix jade stone together, one yet measure each other.

units.zh: 夫黨人之鄙妒兮，羌不知吾所臧。
units.en: Those petty factions in their base jealousy have no inkling of the worth I hold within.
units.literal: That faction people base jealousy, utterly not know my treasures.

units.zh: 任重載盛兮，陷滯而不濟；
units.en: The burden I bear is heavy, the load beyond measure, and I am mired and cannot cross;
units.literal: Bear heavy load full load, trapped stuck not cross;

units.zh: 懷瑾握瑜兮，窮不得余所示。
units.en: I clasp my jade and hold my jewels, but in my extremity, I find no one to whom I may show them.
units.literal: Hold jade embrace purity, poor not get I show.

units.zh: 邑犬群吠兮，吠所怪也；
units.en: The village dogs bark in a pack — they bark at whatever seems strange to them;
units.literal: Village dogs pack bark, bark what strange;

units.zh: 誹駿疑桀兮，固庸態也。
units.en: to slander the excellent and suspect the outstanding is simply the way of the mediocre.
units.literal: Slander the worthy and suspect the outstanding — originally the attitude of the mediocre.

units.zh: 文質疏內兮，眾不知吾之異采；
units.en: My refinement and substance lie within, unadorned — the crowd does not see my singular brilliance;
units.literal: Culture substance coarse inner, crowd not know my different colors;

units.zh: 材樸委積兮，莫知余之所有。
units.en: my timber is rough-hewn and heaped aside, and none know what I possess.
units.literal: Timber simple piled up, none know I have.

units.zh: 重仁襲義兮，謹厚以為豐；
units.en: I pile benevolence upon righteousness, scrupulous and generous in abundance;
units.literal: Heavy benevolence layer righteousness, careful thick as abundance;

units.zh: 重華不可牾兮，孰知余之從容！
units.en: Even Emperor Shun could not fault me — yet who knows the composure in my heart!
units.literal: Chong Hua cannot oppose, who knows my composed!

units.zh: 迸固有不并兮，豈知其故也？
units.en: That the worthy and the base should not stand together has ever been so — yet who grasps the reason?
units.literal: Burst solid have not together, how know its reason?

units.zh: 湯禹久遠兮，邈不可慕也。
units.en: Tang and Yu are far away in the distant past, too remote to serve as models.
units.literal: Tang Yu distant, remote cannot admire.

units.zh: 懲違改忿兮，抑心而自彊；
units.en: I correct my faults and master my anger, restraining my heart to strengthen my resolve;
units.literal: Punish violation change anger, repress heart self strengthen;

units.zh: 離湣而不遷兮，願志之有象。
units.en: though beset by sorrow, I will not waver — I wish only that my purpose may find form.
units.literal: Separated pity not move, wish ambition have image.

units.zh: 進路北次兮，日昧昧其將暮；
units.en: I journey northward and make camp, but the day grows dim as dusk approaches;
units.literal: Advance road north lodge, day dim its will dusk;

units.zh: 含憂虞哀兮，限之以大故。
units.en: sorrow and dread fill my breast, and I am bound by the finality of death.
units.literal: Contain worry fear sorrow, limited by great matter.

units.zh: 亂曰：浩浩沅、湘兮，分流汨兮。
units.en: The envoi says: Vast are the Yuan and the Xiang, their waters parting as they flow into the Mi.
units.literal: Envoi: Vast are the Yuan and Xiang; their waters part as they flow into the Mi.

units.zh: 修路幽拂兮，道遠忽兮。
units.en: The long road stretches dim and tangled; the way ahead disappears into the distance.
units.literal: Long road dark brush, way far suddenly.

units.zh: 曾唫恒悲兮，永嘆慨兮。
units.en: My sighs deepen and my sorrow never lifts; an unending lamentation wells within me.
units.literal: Increasing sigh constant sorrow, eternal sigh indignant.

units.zh: 世既莫吾知兮，人心不可謂兮。
units.en: The world no longer knows me, and the human heart cannot be fathomed.
units.literal: World already none know me, human heart cannot predict.

units.zh: 懷情抱質兮，獨無匹兮。
units.en: I hold my feelings close and cling to my integrity — alone, without a peer.
units.literal: Embrace feelings hold quality, alone without match.

units.zh: 伯樂既歿兮，驥將焉程兮？
units.en: Now that Bo Le is dead, who will judge the worth of a fine steed?
units.literal: Bo Le already dead, steed where appraise?

units.zh: 人生稟命兮，各有所錯兮。
units.en: In this life, each person receives a fate, and each has a place to which he is assigned.
units.literal: Human life receive fate, each has placement.

units.zh: 定心廣志，餘何畏懼兮？
units.en: I steady my heart and broaden my resolve — what have I left to fear?
units.literal: Settle heart broaden ambition, I what fear?

units.zh: 曾傷爰哀，永嘆喟兮。
units.en: The grief deepens, the sorrow mounts — I sigh and sigh without end.
units.literal: Increasingly wounded beloved sorrow, eternal sigh indignant.

units.zh: 世溷不吾知，心不可謂兮。
units.en: The world is muddied and does not know me; the heart cannot be spoken of.
units.literal: World turbid not know me, heart cannot predict.

units.zh: 知死不可讓兮，願勿愛兮。
units.en: I know that death cannot be refused — let me not cling to life.
units.literal: Know death cannot yield, wish not love.

units.zh: 明以告君子兮，吾將以為類兮。
units.en: Let me declare this plainly to the gentlemen of the world: I shall make my death a testament.
units.literal: Clearly tell gentlemen, I will take as example.

units.zh: 於是懷石遂自（投）［沈］汨羅以死。
units.en: And so, clasping a stone to his chest, he cast himself into the Miluo River and drowned.
units.literal: Then embrace stone then self drown Miluo to die.

units.zh: 屈原既死之後，楚有宋玉、唐勒、景差之徒者，皆好辭而以賦見稱；
units.en: After Qu Yuan's death, Chu produced such men as Song Yu, Tang Le, and Jing Chai, all of whom were skilled in literary composition and won renown for their rhapsodies;
units.literal: Qu Yuan already died after, Chu had Song Yu, Tang Le, Jing Chai and others, all good rhetoric and with rhapsodies seen praised;

units.zh: 然皆祖屈原之從容辭令，終莫敢直諫。
units.en: yet all of them merely imitated Qu Yuan's elegant style, and none ever dared to speak in frank remonstrance.
units.literal: Yet all followed Qu Yuan composed rhetoric, finally none dared direct admonish.

units.zh: 其後楚日以削，數十年竟為秦所滅。
units.en: Afterward, Chu declined day by day, and within a few decades it was destroyed by Qin.
units.literal: After this Chu day by day diminished, several decades finally by Qin destroyed.

units.zh: 自屈原沈汨羅後百有餘年，漢有賈生，為長沙王太傅，過湘水，投書以弔屈原。
units.en: More than a hundred years after Qu Yuan drowned in the Miluo, there was a man of the Han named Jia Sheng, who served as Grand Tutor to the King of Changsha. As he crossed the Xiang River, he cast a written elegy into the waters to mourn Qu Yuan.
units.literal: From Qu Yuan drowned Miluo after hundred plus years, Han had Jia Sheng, was Changsha King Taifu, crossed Xiang water, cast letter to lament Qu Yuan.

units.zh: 賈生名誼，雒陽人也。
units.en: Jia Sheng, whose given name was Yi, was a native of Luoyang.
units.literal: Jia Sheng named Yi, Luoyang person.

units.zh: 年十八，以能誦詩屬書聞於郡中。
units.en: By the age of eighteen, he was renowned throughout his commandery for his ability to recite the Odes and compose fine prose.
units.literal: Age eighteen, able recite poetry compose writings famous in commandery.

units.zh: 吳廷尉為河南守，聞其秀才，召置門下，甚幸愛。
units.en: Wu, the Commandant of Justice, was serving as Governor of Henan. When he heard of Jia Yi's talent, he summoned him into his household and treated him with great favor and affection.
units.literal: Wu the Commandant of Justice as Henan governor, heard his talent, summoned placed under his patronage, greatly favored and cherished.

units.zh: 孝文皇帝初立，聞河南守吳公治平為天下第一，故與李斯同邑而常學事焉，乃徵為廷尉。
units.en: When Emperor Wen first ascended the throne, he heard that Wu Gong, the Governor of Henan, governed so well that he was reckoned the finest administrator in the realm. Wu Gong had come from the same town as Li Si and had often studied under him. The emperor summoned Wu Gong to serve as Commandant of Justice.
units.literal: Emperor Wen of Han first ascended throne, heard Henan governor Wu Gong governed peacefully ranked first under heaven, formerly from same town as Li Si and often studied under him, then summoned as Commandant of Justice.

units.zh: 廷尉乃言賈生年少，頗通諸子百家之書。
units.en: The Commandant of Justice then spoke of Jia Sheng, saying that though he was young, he was deeply versed in the writings of the various philosophers and the Hundred Schools of thought.
units.literal: The Commandant of Justice then spoke of Jia Sheng, young, quite versed in the writings of the various philosophers and the Hundred Schools.

units.zh: 文帝召以為博士。
units.en: Emperor Wen summoned him and appointed him as an Erudite.
units.literal: Wen Emperor summoned as erudite.

units.zh: 是時賈生年二十餘，最為少。
units.en: At that time, Jia Sheng was just over twenty years old — the youngest among them.
units.literal: At this time Jia Sheng age twenty plus, most young.

units.zh: 每詔令議下，諸老先生不能言，賈生盡為之對，人人各如其意所欲出。
units.en: Whenever an edict was sent down for deliberation, the elder scholars could find nothing to say, but Jia Sheng answered every point on their behalf, expressing what each of them had wished to say but could not articulate.
units.literal: Every time edicts discussions sent down, various old masters could not speak, Jia Sheng completely answered for them, everyone each as their intention wished out.

units.zh: 諸生於是乃以為能，不及也。
units.en: The other scholars all acknowledged his ability and conceded that they could not match him.
units.literal: Various scholars then considered him able, not inferior.

units.zh: 孝文帝說之，超遷，一歲中至太中大夫。
units.en: Emperor Wen was delighted with him and promoted him rapidly. Within a single year, he rose to the rank of Grand Palace Grandee.
units.literal: Filial Wen Emperor pleased, promoted extraordinarily, one year to Grand Palace Grandee.

units.zh: 賈生以為漢興至孝文二十餘年，天下和洽，而固當改正朔，易服色，法制度，定官名，興禮樂，乃悉草具其事儀法，色尚黃，數用五，為官名，悉更秦之法。
units.en: Jia Sheng believed that more than twenty years had passed since the founding of the Han, and that the realm was now at peace. It was therefore time to reform the calendar, change the ritual colors, revise the laws and institutions, establish proper official titles, and promote the rites and music. He drafted a comprehensive plan for all of these measures, proposing yellow as the dynastic color, the number five as the governing numeral, and new official titles — entirely replacing the old Qin system.
units.literal: Jia Sheng thought Han rise to Filial Wen twenty plus years, world peaceful harmonious, should change calendar, change colors, establish laws systems, fix official names, promote rites music, then completely drafted all matters ceremonies laws, color esteem yellow, number use five, for official names, completely changed Qin laws.

units.zh: 孝文帝初即位，謙讓未遑也。
units.en: Emperor Wen had only recently ascended the throne and, out of modesty and restraint, had not yet found the occasion to act.
units.literal: Filial Wen Emperor initially ascended, modest yielding not leisure.

units.zh: 諸律令所更定，及列侯悉就國，其說皆自賈生發之。
units.en: The various reforms to the statutes and ordinances, as well as the policy of sending all the marquises to their fiefdoms, all originated from Jia Sheng's proposals.
units.literal: Various statutes orders what changed fixed, and marquises all go to states, these theories all from Jia Sheng originated.

units.zh: 於是天子議以為賈生任公卿之位。
units.en: The emperor then considered promoting Jia Sheng to the rank of one of the great ministers of state.
units.literal: Then emperor discussed make Jia Sheng assume duke ministers position.

units.zh: 絳、灌、東陽侯、馮敬之屬盡害之，乃短賈生曰：「雒陽之人，年少初學，專欲擅權，紛亂諸事。」
units.en: But the Marquis of Jiang, Guan Ying, the Marquis of Dongyang, Feng Jing, and others all opposed him. They slandered Jia Sheng, saying: 'This man from Luoyang is young and has barely begun his studies, yet he seeks to monopolize power and throw everything into confusion.'
units.literal: Jiang, Guan, Dongyang Hou, Feng Jing and others all harmed him, then slandered Jia Sheng said: 'Luoyang person, young just studied, monopolize want seize power, confuse various matters.'

units.zh: 於是天子後亦疏之，不用其議，乃以賈生為長沙王太傅。
units.en: The emperor afterward also distanced himself from Jia Sheng and ceased to follow his counsel. He appointed Jia Sheng as Grand Tutor to the King of Changsha.
units.literal: Then emperor afterward also distanced him, not used his proposals, then made Jia Sheng Changsha King Taifu.

units.zh: 賈生既辭往行，聞長沙卑溼，自以壽不得長，又以適去，意不自得。
units.en: Jia Sheng took his leave and departed. He had heard that Changsha was low and damp, and feared he would not live long there. Moreover, having been sent away in disgrace, his spirits were deeply low.
units.literal: Jia Sheng already took leave and departed; heard Changsha was low and damp; thought to himself longevity would not be long; moreover went away in banishment; his spirits were not at ease.

units.zh: 及渡湘水，為賦以弔屈原。
units.en: As he crossed the Xiang River, he composed a rhapsody to mourn Qu Yuan.
units.literal: When crossed Xiang water, made rhapsody to lament Qu Yuan.

units.zh: 其辭曰：
units.en: Its words read:
units.literal: Its words said:

units.zh: 共承嘉惠兮，俟罪長沙。
units.en: I have humbly received the emperor's gracious favor, yet now I await my punishment in Changsha.
units.literal: Together receive fine favor, await crime Changsha.

units.zh: 側聞屈原兮，自沈汨羅。
units.en: I have heard of Qu Yuan, who drowned himself in the Miluo.
units.literal: Side heard Qu Yuan, self drowned Miluo.

units.zh: 造託湘流兮，敬弔先生。
units.en: I entrust these words to the Xiang's current, to pay my respectful tribute to the master.
units.literal: Created entrusted Xiang flow, respectfully lament master.

units.zh: 遭世罔極兮，乃隕厥身。
units.en: He met a world without measure or principle, and so he let his body fall.
units.literal: Encountered world without standard, then fell his body.

units.zh: 嗚呼哀哉，逢時不祥！
units.en: Alas, how grievous! He was born into an inauspicious time!
units.literal: Alas sorrowful, met untimely time!

units.zh: 鸞鳳伏竄兮，鴟梟翺翔：闒茸尊顯兮，讒諛得志；
units.en: The phoenix and the luan hide and cower, while the owl and the kite soar freely: the lowly and worthless are honored and exalted, the slanderers and flatterers achieve their ambitions;
units.literal: Luan phoenix hide conceal, owl kite fly soar: base people honored exalted, slander flatterers get ambition;

units.zh: 賢聖逆曳兮，方正倒植。
units.en: the worthy and the wise are dragged backward, the upright and the honest are planted upside down.
units.literal: Worthy sages dragged backward, upright square inverted planted.

units.zh: 世謂伯夷貪兮，謂盜跖廉；
units.en: The world calls Bo Yi greedy and Robber Zhi virtuous;
units.literal: World calls Bo Yi greedy, calls Dao Zhi frugal;

units.zh: 莫邪為頓兮，鉛刀為铦。
units.en: the sword Mo Ye is deemed blunt, while a knife of lead is called keen.
units.literal: Mo Ye made blunt, lead knife made sharp.

units.zh: 于嗟嚜嚜兮，生之無故！
units.en: Alas, how dark, how dark — this life without reason!
units.literal: Alas dark dark, life without reason!

units.zh: 斡棄周鼎兮寶康瓠，騰駕罷牛兮驂蹇驢，驥垂兩耳兮服鹽車。
units.en: They cast aside the sacred Zhou tripod and treasure a hollow gourd; they harness an exhausted ox with a lame donkey for a team, while the fine steed droops its ears, yoked to a salt cart.
units.literal: Swirled abandoned Zhou tripod treasured calabash, mounted drove exhausted ox hitched lame donkey, steed hung two ears yoked salt cart.

units.zh: 章甫薦屨兮，漸不可久；
units.en: A noble cap is used to line a shoe — such an inversion cannot last;
units.literal: Zhang Fu presented shoe, gradually cannot last;

units.zh: 嗟苦先生兮，獨離此咎！
units.en: Alas, poor Master — you alone bore the blame for this!
units.literal: Alas bitter master, alone separated this blame!

units.zh: 訊曰：已矣，國其莫我知，獨堙郁兮其誰語？
units.en: The envoi says: It is over! None in the realm know me — I choke in solitary anguish, and to whom can I speak?
units.literal: Message says: Finished, state none know me, alone choked pent up who speak to?

units.zh: 鳳漂漂其高遰兮，夫固自縮而遠去。
units.en: The phoenix drifts aloft and soars away — it withdraws of its own accord and departs into the distance.
units.literal: The phoenix drifts aloft and far away; it indeed withdraws of itself and departs into the distance.

units.zh: 襲九淵之神龍兮，沕深潛以自珍。
units.en: Like the divine dragon of the nine abysses, it dives deep and hides, treasuring itself in secret.
units.literal: Followed nine abysses divine dragon, swam deep hidden self treasure.

units.zh: 彌融爚以隱處兮，夫豈從螘與蛭螾？
units.en: It shines with a radiance that conceals itself — how could it ever keep company with ants and leeches?
units.literal: It shines radiantly while hidden in its lair — how could it keep company with ants and leeches?

units.zh: 所貴聖人之神德兮，遠濁世而自藏。
units.en: What we prize in the sage is his divine virtue — he withdraws far from the turbid world and conceals himself.
units.literal: What valued sage man divine virtue, far turbid world self hide.

units.zh: 使騏驥可得系羈兮，豈云異夫犬羊！
units.en: If a fine steed could be tethered and bridled like any beast, how would it differ from dogs and sheep!
units.literal: Make steed can get tied restrained, how say different from dogs sheep!

units.zh: 般紛紛其離此尤兮，亦夫子之辜也！
units.en: That all this turmoil should descend upon you was also, in part, the Master's own doing!
units.literal: Generally confused left this blame, also master guilt!

units.zh: 瞝九州而相君兮，何必懷此都也？
units.en: You could have looked across the Nine Provinces to find a worthy lord — why cling so stubbornly to this one capital?
units.literal: Look nine provinces choose lord, why must cherish this capital?

units.zh: 鳳皇翔于千仞之上兮，覽德惪而下之；
units.en: The phoenix soars a thousand ren above, and only when it surveys true virtue below does it descend;
units.literal: Phoenix soars thousand ren above, views virtue solid descend it;

units.zh: 見細德之險（微）［徵］兮，搖增翮逝而去之。
units.en: when it sees the slightest sign of faltering virtue, it beats its wings and soars away.
units.literal: See small virtue danger omen, shake increase wings departed gone.

units.zh: 彼尋常之汙瀆兮，豈能容吞舟之魚！
units.en: How could an ordinary ditch ever contain a fish large enough to swallow a boat!
units.literal: That ordinary dirty ditch, how can contain swallow boat fish!

units.zh: 橫江湖之鱣鱏兮，固將制於蟻螻。
units.en: The great sturgeon that rules the rivers and lakes will surely be mastered at last by ants and mole crickets.
units.literal: Horizontal rivers lakes sturgeon, indeed will controlled by ants mole crickets.

units.zh: 賈生為長沙王太傅三年，有鸮飛入賈生舍，止于坐隅。
units.en: After Jia Sheng had served as Grand Tutor to the King of Changsha for three years, an owl flew into his lodgings and perched in the corner of his seat.
units.literal: Jia Sheng was Changsha King Taifu three years, had owl fly enter Jia Sheng dwelling, stopped at seat corner.

units.zh: 楚人命鸮曰「服」。
units.en: The people of Chu call the owl 'fu.'
units.literal: Chu people call owl 'Fu'.

units.zh: 賈生既以適居長沙，長沙卑溼，自以為壽不得長，傷悼之，乃為賦以自廣。
units.en: Jia Sheng had been banished to live in Changsha, which was low and damp. Believing he would not live long, he grieved deeply and composed a rhapsody to console himself.
units.literal: Jia Sheng already banished live Changsha, Changsha low wet, self thought longevity not long, wounded mourned it, then made rhapsody self console.

units.zh: 其辭曰：
units.en: Its words read:
units.literal: Its words said:

units.zh: 單閼之歲兮，四月孟夏，庚子日施兮，服集予舍，止于坐隅，貌甚閒暇。
units.en: In the year of Shanhe, in the fourth month of early summer, on the gengzi day, an owl alighted on my dwelling and perched in the corner of my seat, looking perfectly at ease.
units.literal: In the year Shanhe, in the fourth month of early summer, on the day Gengzi, the fu owl gathered at my dwelling, stopped at the corner of my seat, its appearance very leisurely.

units.zh: 異物來集兮，私怪其故，發書占之兮，筴言其度。
units.en: A strange creature had come to alight — in private, I wondered at the reason. I opened a book of divination to consult the oracle, and the bamboo slips spoke of its portent.
units.literal: Strange thing come gather, privately strange its reason, sent book divine it, bamboo spoke its measure.

units.zh: 曰「野鳥入處兮，主人將去」。
units.en: They said: 'When a wild bird enters the dwelling, the master is about to depart.'
units.literal: Said 'wild bird enter dwelling, master will go'.

units.zh: 請問于服兮：「予去何之？
units.en: I asked the owl: 'Where shall I go?
units.literal: Please ask Fu: 'I go where?

units.zh: 吉乎告我，凶言其菑。
units.en: If it is auspicious, tell me so; if ill-omened, speak of the calamity to come.
units.literal: Auspicious tell me, inauspicious speak its calamity.

units.zh: 淹數之度兮，語予其期。」
units.en: Reckon the span of my days, and tell me when the hour will come.'
units.literal: Soak several measure, tell me its time.

units.zh: 服乃嘆息，舉首奮翼，口不能言，請對以意。
units.en: The owl sighed, raised its head, and beat its wings. Its mouth could not speak, but it seemed to answer with its intent.
units.literal: Fu then sighed, raised head shook wings, mouth cannot speak, please respond with intention.

units.zh: 萬物變化兮，固無休息。
units.en: The myriad things are ever-changing — there is never any rest.
units.literal: Myriad things change, indeed no rest.

units.zh: 斡流而遷兮，或推而還。
units.en: They revolve and flow and shift; pushed forward, they circle back again.
units.literal: Rotate flow migrate, or push return.

units.zh: 形氣轉續兮，變化而嬗。
units.en: Form and breath pass on in ceaseless succession, changing and transforming without end.
units.literal: Form qi transfer continue, change transform.

units.zh: 沕穆無窮兮，胡可勝言！
units.en: Boundless and unfathomable — how could words ever encompass it!
units.literal: Swim silent no end, how can exhaust speak!

units.zh: 禍兮福所倚，福兮禍所伏；
units.en: Misfortune — that is where fortune leans; fortune — that is where misfortune hides;
units.literal: Calamity fortune depend on each other, fortune calamity lie hidden;

units.zh: 憂喜聚門兮，吉凶同域。
units.en: sorrow and joy gather at the same gate, the auspicious and the dire share the same ground.
units.literal: Worry joy gather gate, auspicious inauspicious same region.

units.zh: 彼吳彊大兮，夫差以敗；
units.en: The state of Wu was mighty and strong, yet Fu Chai met defeat;
units.literal: That Wu strong great, Fu Chai with defeat;

units.zh: 越棲會稽兮，句踐霸世。
units.en: Yue cowered at Kuaiji, yet Goujian rose to dominate the age.
units.literal: Yue dwell Kuaiji, Gou Jian hegemon world.

units.zh: 斯游遂成兮，卒被五刑；
units.en: Li Si roamed and achieved success, yet in the end he suffered the Five Punishments;
units.literal: Si You finally succeed, finally received five punishments;

units.zh: 傅說胥靡兮，乃相武丁。
units.en: Fu Yue toiled as a convict laborer, yet rose to become chief minister to King Wu Ding.
units.literal: Fu Yue slave labor, then became minister Wu Ding.

units.zh: 夫禍之與福兮，何異糾纆。
units.en: Misfortune and fortune — how are they any different from the strands of a twisted rope?
units.literal: That calamity and fortune, what different twisted rope.

units.zh: 命不可說兮，孰知其極？
units.en: Fate cannot be explained — who knows where it will end?
units.literal: Fate cannot explain, who knows its limit?

units.zh: 水激則旱兮，矢激則遠。
units.en: Water forced through a narrow channel shoots high; an arrow released from a drawn bow flies far.
units.literal: Water forced through a narrow channel shoots upward; an arrow released from a drawn bow flies far.

units.zh: 萬物回薄兮，振蕩相轉。
units.en: The myriad things surge and press upon one another, buffeted and turning without cease.
units.literal: Myriad things return press, shake sway transfer each other.

units.zh: 雲蒸雨降兮，錯繆相紛。
units.en: Clouds rise as steam and rain descends; all is tangled and interwoven.
units.literal: Cloud steam rain fall, wrong error mix confused.

units.zh: 大專槃物兮，坱軋無垠。
units.en: The great Way encompasses all things, vast and boundless, without limit.
units.literal: Great concentrated encompass things, vast press no border.

units.zh: 天不可與慮兮，道不可與謀。
units.en: Heaven cannot be reasoned with; the Way cannot be plotted against.
units.literal: Heaven cannot with deliberate, way cannot with plan.

units.zh: 遲數有命兮，惡識其時？
units.en: Whether slow or swift, all is fated — who can know the appointed hour?
units.literal: Slow hasten have fate, how know its time?

units.zh: 且夫天地為鑪兮，造化為工；
units.en: Heaven and earth are the furnace; creation itself is the smith;
units.literal: Moreover, heaven earth furnace, creation worker;

units.zh: 陰陽為炭兮，萬物為銅。
units.en: yin and yang are the charcoal; the myriad things are the bronze.
units.literal: Yin yang charcoal, myriad things copper.

units.zh: 合散消息兮，安有常則；
units.en: Combining and dispersing, waxing and waning — where is there any constant law?
units.literal: Combine disperse grow decline, how have constant rule;

units.zh: 千變萬化兮，未始有極。
units.en: A thousand changes, ten thousand transformations — from the beginning, there has never been an end.
units.literal: Thousand change ten thousand transform, never have limit.

units.zh: 忽然為人兮，何足控摶；
units.en: To become a human being in a sudden moment — what is there to cling to?
units.literal: Suddenly become person, what sufficient hold grasp;

units.zh: 化為異物兮，又何足患！
units.en: To be transformed into some other being — why should that be cause for grief!
units.literal: Transform become different thing, again what sufficient worry!

units.zh: 小知自私兮，賤彼貴我；
units.en: The small-minded are selfish, despising others and prizing themselves;
units.literal: Small knowledge self private, despise that value I;

units.zh: 通人大觀兮，物無不可。
units.en: the man of broad understanding takes the great view, and to him nothing is unacceptable.
units.literal: Penetrating great person view, things none not can.

units.zh: 貪夫徇財兮，烈士徇名；
units.en: The greedy man dies for wealth; the man of fierce conviction dies for fame;
units.literal: Greedy man follow wealth, fierce knight follow name;

units.zh: 夸者死權兮，品庶馮生。
units.en: the vainglorious die for power, while the common people simply cling to life.
units.literal: Boaster die power, common people rely life.

units.zh: 述迫之徒兮，或趨西東；
units.en: Those whom the times press and constrain rush hither and thither, east and west;
units.literal: Those pressed by the times, or hurry east and west;

units.zh: 大人不曲兮，億變齊同。
units.en: but the great man does not bend — amid a hundred million changes, all is the same to him.
units.literal: Great person not bend, hundred million change same same.

units.zh: 拘士系俗兮，攌如囚拘；
units.en: The narrow-minded scholar is bound by convention, fettered like a prisoner in chains;
units.literal: Constrain knight tie custom, tied like prisoner;

units.zh: 至人遺物兮，獨與道俱。
units.en: but the perfected man transcends the world of things and dwells alone with the Way.
units.literal: Perfect person abandon things, alone with way together.

units.zh: 眾人或或兮，好惡積意；
units.en: The common crowd wavers this way and that, their likes and dislikes piling up within them;
units.literal: Crowd people various, good bad accumulate intention;

units.zh: 真人淡漠兮，獨與道息。
units.en: but the true man is serene and detached, resting alone with the Way.
units.literal: True person indifferent, alone with way rest.

units.zh: 釋知遺形兮，超然自喪；
units.en: He releases knowledge and abandons form, transcending and forgetting himself;
units.literal: Release knowledge abandon form, transcend self forget;

units.zh: 寥廓忽荒兮，與道翺翔。
units.en: in the vast and boundless emptiness, he soars with the Way.
units.literal: Vast suddenly vast, with way soar fly.

units.zh: 乘流則逝兮，得坻則止；
units.en: He rides the current and goes where it takes him; when he reaches a bank, he stops;
units.literal: Ride current then go, get shore then stop;

units.zh: 縱軀委命兮，不私與己。
units.en: he releases his body and entrusts himself to fate, without a thought of self.
units.literal: Free body entrust fate, not private with self.

units.zh: 其生若浮兮，其死若休；
units.en: His life is like drifting; his death is like rest;
units.literal: His life like float, his death like rest;

units.zh: 澹乎若深淵之靜，氾乎若不系之舟。
units.en: he is tranquil as a still, deep pool, and unmoored as a boat adrift without a tether.
units.literal: Indifferent like deep abyss quiet, vast like not tied boat.

units.zh: 不以生故自寶兮，養空而浮；
units.en: He does not prize himself merely because he is alive, but nourishes emptiness and floats free;
units.literal: Not because life reason self treasure, nurture empty float;

units.zh: 德人無累兮，知命不憂。
units.en: the man of virtue bears no burdens — knowing his fate, he does not grieve.
units.literal: Virtue person no burden, know fate not worry.

units.zh: 細故遰葪兮，何足以疑！
units.en: Petty matters and trifling cares — what reason is there to be troubled by them!
units.literal: Small matter far small, what sufficient doubt!

units.zh: 後歲餘，賈生徵見。
units.en: More than a year later, Jia Sheng was summoned back to court for an audience.
units.literal: After year plus, Jia Sheng summoned appear.

units.zh: 孝文帝方受釐，坐宣室。
units.en: Emperor Wen had just performed a sacrificial offering and was seated in the Xuanshi Hall.
units.literal: Filial Wen Emperor just received ceremony, sat Xuanshi.

units.zh: 上因感鬼神事，而問鬼神之本。
units.en: The emperor, moved by thoughts of ghosts and spirits, asked about the origin and nature of the spiritual world.
units.literal: Emperor because sense ghost spirit matters, ask ghost spirit origin.

units.zh: 賈生因具道所以然之狀。
units.en: Jia Sheng explained in full the reasons and principles behind these matters.
units.literal: Jia Sheng then completely explain so reason condition.

units.zh: 至夜半，文帝前席。
units.en: By midnight, Emperor Wen had moved forward to the edge of his mat, leaning in to listen.
units.literal: To midnight, Wen Emperor advance mat.

units.zh: 既罷，曰：「吾久不見賈生，自以為過之，今不及也。」
units.en: When the audience was over, the emperor said: 'I have not seen Jia Sheng for a long time, and I thought I had surpassed him. Now I see I am not his equal.'
units.literal: After finished, said: 'I long not see Jia Sheng, self think surpass him, now not equal.'

units.zh: 居頃之，拜賈生為梁懷王太傅。
units.en: Shortly afterward, he appointed Jia Sheng as Grand Tutor to King Huai of Liang.
units.literal: Dwell moment, appoint Jia Sheng Liang Huai King Taifu.

units.zh: 梁懷王，文帝之少子，愛，而好書，故令賈生傅之。
units.en: King Huai of Liang was Emperor Wen's youngest son, whom the emperor loved dearly. The prince was fond of learning, and so the emperor appointed Jia Sheng as his tutor.
units.literal: Liang Huai King, Wen Emperor young son, loved, and good books, therefore make Jia Sheng tutor him.

units.zh: 文帝復封淮南厲王子四人皆為列侯。
units.en: Emperor Wen once again enfeoffed all four sons of the cruel King of Huainan as marquises.
units.literal: Wen Emperor again enfeoff four sons of Huainan Li King all as marquises.

units.zh: 賈生諫，以為患之興自此起矣。
units.en: Jia Sheng remonstrated, warning that calamity would arise from this.
units.literal: Jia Sheng admonished, thought calamity rise from this.

units.zh: 賈生數上疏，言諸侯或連數郡，非古之制，可稍削之。
units.en: Jia Sheng submitted memorials on multiple occasions, arguing that some feudal lords controlled territories spanning several commanderies, which was contrary to the ancient system, and that their domains should be gradually reduced.
units.literal: Jia Sheng several times submit memorials, speak marquises some connect several commanderies, not ancient system, can gradually reduce them.

units.zh: 文帝不聽。
units.en: Emperor Wen did not heed him.
units.literal: Wen Emperor not listen.

units.zh: 居數年，懷王騎，墮馬而死，無後。
units.en: A few years later, King Huai went riding, fell from his horse, and died. He left no heir.
units.literal: Dwell several years, Huai King ride horse, fall horse die, no posterity.

units.zh: 賈生自傷為傅無狀，哭泣歲餘，亦死。
units.en: Jia Sheng blamed himself bitterly for having failed as a tutor. He wept for more than a year, and then he too died.
units.literal: Jia Sheng self blame as tutor without achievement, cry weep year plus, also die.

units.zh: 賈生之死時年三十三矣。
units.en: At the time of his death, Jia Sheng was only thirty-three years old.
units.literal: Jia Sheng death time age thirty three.

units.zh: 及孝文崩，孝武皇帝立，舉賈生之孫二人至郡守，而賈嘉最好學，世其家，與余通書。
units.en: After Emperor Wen passed away and Emperor Wu ascended the throne, two of Jia Sheng's grandsons were promoted to the rank of commandery governor. Among them, Jia Jia was the most devoted to learning. He carried on the family tradition and exchanged letters with me.
units.literal: When Filial Wen passed, Filial Wu Emperor established, raise Jia Sheng two grandsons to commandery governors, Jia Jia most good learning, inherit family, with me communicate writings.

units.zh: 至孝昭時，列為九卿。
units.en: By the time of Emperor Zhao, he had risen to the rank of one of the Nine Ministers.
units.literal: To Filial Zhao time, listed as nine ministers.

units.zh: 太史公曰：余讀離騷、天問、招魂、哀郢，悲其志。
units.en: The Grand Historian remarks: When I read the 'Encountering Sorrow,' the 'Heavenly Questions,' the 'Summoning the Soul,' and the 'Lament for Ying,' I grieve for Qu Yuan's resolve.
units.literal: Grand Historian said: I read Li Sao, Tian Wen, Zhao Hun, Ai Ying, grieve his ambition.

units.zh: 適長沙，觀屈原所自沈淵，未嘗不垂涕，想見其為人。
units.en: When I traveled to Changsha and stood at the abyss where Qu Yuan drowned himself, I could not help but weep, picturing in my mind what manner of man he was.
units.literal: Went Changsha, view Qu Yuan where self drowned abyss, never not shed tears, imagine see his person.

units.zh: 及見賈生弔之，又怪屈原以彼其材，游諸侯，何國不容，而自令若是。
units.en: And when I read Jia Sheng's elegy for him, I wondered further: with such talents as Qu Yuan possessed, he could have traveled among the feudal lords — what state would not have welcomed him? Yet he brought himself to such an end.
units.literal: When see Jia Sheng lament him, again strange Qu Yuan with his talent, travel various lords, what country not contain, yet self make like this.

units.zh: 讀服烏賦，同死生，輕去就，又爽然自失矣。
units.en: Then I read Jia Yi's 'Rhapsody on the Owl,' in which life and death are made equal and coming and going are taken lightly, and once again I was struck with a sudden sense of loss.
units.literal: Read Fu Ou assignment, same death life, light leave take, again clearly self lost.
